title: nominationData
description: Nomination context containing the network location, balancing group, nomination period, hourly granularity, unit and nomination time series.

internalAccount.description: Internal balancing group identifier for which the nomination is submitted.

period.description: Period covered by the nomination, represented as an ISO 8601 interval or duration expression.

granularity.description: Duration of each nomination interval. PT1H represents one hour.

nominations.description: Nomination time series for the specified location, internal account and nomination period.
